About the job

Isotrol is a worldwide market leader in Energy Market Trading Software Solutions and Renewable Power Plant Control Solutions. We help companies in the renewable energy sector transform efficient renewable power plant control solutions ideas into software solutions realities. We have been powering the largest energy companies for over three decades, managing more than 100+ GWTs across the globe. And what is most exciting about it is that this is only the beginning.

At Isotrol, we are immersed in a transformation process where we are creating SaaS solutions with cutting edge technology to adapt not only to the largest clients, but to be able to adapt to all companies in the sector. What we do is deeply connected to create a more sustainable world, and our team members are the most valuable asset and where our success as a company starts. We’re a team of over 350 people across 5 countries (Spain, USA, Mexico, Brazil and Chile) delivering expert knowledge, passion and commitment to support our clients in the achievement of a more sustainable world.

The position:

We are looking for two new Systems and Networking Technician profiles, for the configuration, commissioning, management and support of infrastructures, systems and networks linked to renewable energy generation customers.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Deployments and maintenance of physical and virtualized infrastructures. Mastering of infrastructure linked to new projects or evolution of existing systems (server infrastructure, virtual machines and OT equipment).
  • Administration and management of Isotrol Mexico's corporate infrastructure.
  • Configuration of network elements (routers, firewall, switches, ...).
  • Incident resolution of hardware/software systems and networks.
  • Configuration and administration of computer equipment (servers, PCs and peripherals).
  • Operating systems administration (MS Windows and GNU/Linux).
  • Administration and management of infrastructure (systems and networks) installed in renewable energy projects.
  • Administration and management of Isotrol Mexico's IT park.

Your skills and experience:

  • Possess at least 2 years of experience in the tasks described and have training and Computer Engineering, Telecommunications or CFGS of related branches with experience in the field of renewable or energy sector.
  • Knowledge in computer systems administration and virtualization systems (VMWare/Hyper-V).
  • Knowledge in configuration and administration of storage cabinets, storage networks and ethernet networks.
  • English: minimum B2

What we offer:

  • 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.
  • Possibility of hybrid work (after the probationary period)
  • Medical insurance (for the employee)

Here at Isotrol, we are committed to building a culturally diverse workforce and therefore strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups. We are committed to equality of opportunity and welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of their background.
